summary: Melar Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting that on October 14, 2026 target Everli Global Inc. issued a press release outlining its retail-network business model, attached as Exhibit 99.1. The parties' July 30, 2025 merger agreement, as amended, remains pending; a Form S-4 proxy/prospectus was declared effective, with a September 28, 2026 record date and mailed definitive materials. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were restated in this excerpt. Watch redemption levels, closing timing, and any S-4 supplement risk before the shareholder vote.
